notes.title: Code Name OD Small Update
notes.content:
Added to new version of Code Name OD just released!
thing added:
1) Beta version of the main menu (the final main menu version will release with the final version of Operation Dawn
2) in-game achievements
we added in-game achievements for doing stuff in the level (included an achievement hunter for collecting all of the achievements. More achievements will release later with the regular updates)

notes.title: World War 1: OG Update
notes.content:
In celebration of the release of The Nova War we decided to give you little memories from the time the game was released. From today until May 16th World War 1 will revert to its very first update, this is not permanent and will return to the regular version on May 16th.
It should be noted that the game will never receive any more updates. We are waiting to share with you experiences from the development of The Nova War

notes.title: RUINED Part 2 DLC Update!!!
notes.content:
We are removing RUINED 2 from the STEAM store because the final product was not exactly what we wanted it to be.
Since the DLC was free we will not issue a refund or offer a replacement DLC for the owners, those who have already received the DLC for free are asked to delete it from the content that is downloaded together with the game.
People who do not do this will not receive anything as we are deleting from the game files the map and all the content that was in RUINED 2.
We may do something similar with RUINED 1 as well, but because the DLC cost money for the players we will not offer a refund but will offer a replacement DLC that will have an activation code for the RUINED Part 1 onwers.
Details about that later on....

notes.title: Halloween Nightmare's 2023 Update
notes.content:
Today is the day, and today is Halloween Nightmare's update.
What's new:
The design of the existing maps has been changed for Halloween, in 5 days Blade, the second skin of the Future Pass will be released, there are 3 new and powerful weapons, and more surprises to come.
Halloween Nightmare's update will stay for a whole month!
That means all Halloween weapons stay until November 15th.

Happy Early Halloween

notes.title: World War 1 Halloween Nightmare's Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
On October 15th the "Halloween Nightmare's" update will be released, what to expect from the update:
1. Modification to existing weapons
2. 3 new major weapons including Phobophobia's Nightmare Rifle and Horde Rush Pistol and another new weapon coming on October 31st
3. New map for RUINED Part 1
4. New skin for Future Pass released during October
5. Scary modification for all of the existing maps

Happy Halloween🎃

notes.title: 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
In the 2.0 update, a lot of new features came out!
which include:
1. The new weapons are out in the base game
2. There is a new option of choosing characters that you can play with both in DLC and in the base game!
The new characters are: Liam, a short man with strange telepathic abilities.
Noya, a strong and crazy woman than what you think.
Manny, the game's default character.
And more on the way!!!
3. Every character in the game will get for a limited time in the game their own weapon, in the next week a new weapon will release called "Liam's Special RPG" after it will get vaulted Noia's weapon will be released 
And more surprises to come

notes.title: Weapon Update
notes.content:
In the last update, we released a new weapon to RUINED called the Double Barrel Shotgun that fires 2 bullets in a hit and doubles up to triple the damage to the enemies. But with the celebration we need to make room for the new weapon and therefore the old shotgun got vaulted until we decide otherwise.
The Double Barrel Shotgun makes an initial appearance in RUINED and will eventually appear in the base game

notes.title: Update on game engine version
notes.content:
In the next few hours we are going to release an update to both packages (including the base game and the DLC) that are going to transfer the source code to UNREAL ENGINE 5.3
We expect the update to bring us the multiplayer mode but expect the unexpected

notes.title: Update on capabilities
notes.content:
After testing and updating we managed to reduce the requirements of the RUINED DLC and can run on  budget computers.
On the 30.9.2023 there is going to be an 80% sale on RUINED and every DLC released until then.

notes.title: Update on the DLC
notes.content: A problem arose that some players could not play the DLC. The problem has been fixed and tested successfully. We are very sorry that some of you had to encounter this technical problem. That's why the second DLC of RUINED is going to be completely free and in addition, there will soon be an event where players can get prizes and more...

notes.title: Small Patch Notes
notes.content: We were aware that some players did not understand the multiplayer. So inside the game we added a message that will appear once when you start the game that will tell you to change the settings in "Start A Game" to change that instead of "Online or Lan" the player will put "Offline"
